ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels, with the majority of high-intensity pixels concentrated on the interior of the right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe contains a large, contiguous high-intensity (white) geometric blob spanning the mid-lobe to the interior edge, interspersed with low-intensity circular mottling. Left lobe is predominantly low-intensity with thin, horizontal high-intensity striations near the distal tip. A high-intensity region also borders the upper margin of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees, exhibiting sharp convergence at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. The right lobe trailing edge shows high-amplitude peaks (3-5 pixels) and jagged valleys. The left lobe trailing edge displays more moderate, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips, with the right lobe displaying a more pronounced vertical lift than the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-intensity (dark) circular clusters and rings detected within the white region of the right lobe. Dense, high-intensity (white/calcified) clusters of roughly circular nodes are visible at the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned high-intensity (white) linear marks crossing the low-intensity (black) central region and extending into the right lobe, oriented primarily in vertical and diagonal vectors.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the right fluke tip, creating a highly irregular, protruding geometric profile composed of high-intensity calcified clusters.
other_distinctive_markers: Several distinct 'islands' of low-intensity pixels (black spots) isolated within the primary high-intensity (white) field of the right lobe.
